label: WRONG
reason: Core files (http-adapter.ts, injector.ts, router-explorer.ts) import only @nestjs/common and local modules, but both outliers are the designed lazy-load points for the optional peer dependency @nestjs/microservices (nest-factory.ts:141 loadPackage(() => import('@nestjs/microservices')), nest-application.ts:631/767 tryLoadPackage/optionalRequire), a recurring category (same pattern for @nestjs/websockets) that a new integration point would repeat, so 0 of 2 counted outliers are mistakes; no oxlint import restriction exists. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since a static import from microservices in core would be a real boundary break; 'declared dependencies excepted' is also unclear because microservices is a declared peerDependency in packages/core/package.json.
